'''Hunter's End''' is the lair of [[Artio]]. It is a [[singles-plus combat]] [[dungeon]] located in the [[Wilderness]], north-west of [[Ferox Enclave]]. To enter the lair, players must have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]], '''OR''' they must have a Callisto boss Slayer task (a bear Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement). 

While the entrance to Hunter's End is found in level 20 Wilderness, the cave itself is in level 21 Wilderness, meaning items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness is recommended in the event of [[player killers]] arriving.

[[File:Lesser wilderness bosses map.png|thumb|left|300px|The entrances to the lesser bosses' lairs.]]
Entering the boss lairs requires players to pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. Whenever a player dies to another player, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer. Players can decrease the fee by killing the three bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins.

Upon entering the lair, if players have recently attacked Artio, they will be unable to [[teleport]] for 3 [[ticks]] unless they have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]].

In order to peek inside the lair, the player must have at least 20 kills registered in their name.
